fact: The diagnostic says São Tomé and Príncipe's ID system and an automated fingerprint identification system (in place since 2021) were developed in-house, and that the SIGA civil registration system was internally developed by the registry directorate's technicians with support from the University of Aveiro, which still maintains it and hosts it in Portugal.
title: Identification for Development (ID4D): Diagnostic of ID Systems in São Tomé e Príncipe
